Name: Reverberating Terror
Text: Up to 2 chosen units and structures get -1 power until end of turn.

Name: Forgemaster's Resilience
Text: Chosen unit gains Stalwart until end of turn.

Name: Frostfire Breath
Text: Deal 2 damage to chosen exhausted non-Scratch asset. If that asset is killed, draw a card.

Name: Leyline Regrowth
Text: Return up to one chosen unit card from your discard pile to your hand. Draw a card.

Name: Soul Whip
Text: Chosen allied unit deals damage equal to its power to chosen opposing unit.

Name: Awaken Nightmare
Text: Move chosen opposing unit from the Main Theater to its owner's Reserves. All opposing units get -1 power until end of turn.

Name: Consuming Earth
Text: Kill chosen opposing unit with power less than or equal to the total Requisition yield of all structures you control.

Name: Rage's Wake
Text: Chosen unit gets +2 power until end of turn. When that unit is killed this turn, deploy it from your discard pile to your Reserves for free.

Name: Seismic Instability
Text:
Deal 3 damage to all assets in the Main Theater.
Deal 4 damage to all structures in the Main Theater.

Name: Light of the World Soul
Text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may deploy up to 2 unit cards from among them for free, and put up to 1 of those cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
